The next call clears `configRestored`, then returns a write error before registering cleanup. If permissions recover, the retry skips installation and runs Codex without the configured MCP servers. Clear `configRestored` only after installation succeeds. Also clean up any partial write before returning an installation error. Apply the same correction to Copilot's `configRestored` and Gemini's `settingsRestored`.

** Major** · **Data Integrity & Integration** · **Quick win** **Keep the original backup until a restore succeeds.** `restoreMCPConfig` sets `configRestored` before it writes or removes the file. If that restore fails, the flag is still true. The next `SendMessage` then calls `writeMCPConfig`, which replaces `originalConfig` with the generated file still on disk. A later successful restore writes that generated content back. Before this change, the same later restore wrote the saved original, so this change makes the recovery path lose the original. Set the flag only after a restore succeeds. A failed restore then keeps the original backup. The next call runs against the generated file that is still present, and its restore uses the original backup again. Apply the same change to Codex (`restoreMCPConfig` in `pkg/ai/agent/codexcli/client.go`) and Gemini (`restoreSettings` in `pkg/ai/agent/geminicli/client.go`, using `settingsRestored`).
